evidence.quote: Patients who are uninsured or underinsured that do not have the necessary available funds to pay for services, and have a household income at or below 200% of Federal Poverty Guidelines (FPG) (shown in the table below) may receive free care (an 100% discount.)

tiers.description: 75% discount off gross charges per table; patient will not pay more than AGB
50% discount off gross charges per table; patient will not pay more than AGB
25% discount off gross charges per table; patient will not pay more than AGB

evidence.quote: Individuals that do not have the necessary available funds to pay for services, with annual household incomes between 201% and 400% FPG will be eligible for up to a 75% discount of gross charges, as illustrated by the table below.

asset_test.details: Patients with verified available cash on hand (liquid assets) to pay hospital balances are not eligible; cash on hand is considered in addition to income and family size.

evidence.quote: Patients who have verified available cash on hand (liquid assets) to pay hospital owed balances will not be eligible for financial assistance, per this FAP.
Financial assistance will be considered at any point in the billing cycle, up to 240 days from the 1st billed date, post discharge date or date of service.

how_to_apply: Submit a complete application in person or by mail to BTNRH at 555 North 30th Street, Omaha, NE 68131; by phone call 531-355-8195; applications are also available at East and West Admissions and online.
warnings: Policy purpose statement says household income between 100% and 400% FPG, while the eligibility section gives free care at or below 200% FPG; the eligibility section was used.
Discount text says 'up to a 75% discount' for 201%-400%, while the table gives 75%, 50%, 25% tiers by band; the table was used.
Underinsured patients (insured with out-of-pocket costs) are eligible, but patients must have no sufficient available funds/cash on hand.
Application window counted from '1st billed date, post discharge date or date of service' is ambiguous.
Eligible only for emergency or medically necessary care.
